intentions: Allow customers to place orders with multiple products
Enable customer search for orders and invoices
Expose core functionality through a command-line interface (CLI)
Handle errors gracefully and provide clear user feedback
Maintain a modular and reasonably structured codebase
Manage product inventory including stock quantities and category assignments
Provide administrators with tools to manage products and categories
Separate business logic from data persistence layers
Track order status (pending, confirmed, shipped, cancelled) with stock reservation and release logic
Validate user inputs to ensure data integrity
